collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a healer or elder)

collection.description: A healer's fish-oil salve helps a villager's knees but makes the hut smell: keep using it, or ask for a less fishy one.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) has made (subject) a salve for (subject.his/her) aching knees. It's made of fish oil, crushed leaves and something (friend) refuses to name. It might help with the stiffness. It certainly smells. By evening (subject)'s hut smells like a fish rack in the sun, and the cats from three huts over are sitting outside the door.

choices.label: Ask for a Less Fishy One

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) decides (subject.his/her) knees are more important than the smell. (subject.He/she) uses the salve every night for two weeks. The knees do feel a bit looser, especially in the mornings. The cats are now (subject.his/her) closest friends. (subject.His/her) family has started sleeping with leaves over their noses. Everyone agrees it's worth it, except the family.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) asks very politely if there's a version that smells less like the bottom of a canoe. (friend) thinks. "I could try it with coconut oil. It might not work as well. Or it might work better. I don't know." The coconut salve smells lovely. It helps a little less, or maybe the same. (subject) can't tell. The cats lose interest. (subject) is a bit sad about that.
